“The Pentagon has an obligation to explain itself to the American people, to our allies, even to our adversaries... and they’re just, in my mind, completely failing.”

Rear Adm. John Kirby tells @markhertling.bsky.social the lack of transparency surrounding the war with Iran is a travesty.
posts.summary: Pentagon failing to provide transparency on Iran war
